intro: Redact PDF genuinely removes information that must not be seen: names, ID numbers, bank accounts, addresses or any part of a document you are about to share. Putting a black rectangle on top is not enough, because the text underneath can still be copied or recovered; here whatever you cover disappears from the file. Everything happens in your browser, so the document with the data still visible never leaves your device.

You can draw the areas by hand on each page, search for a piece of text and redact every occurrence at once, or turn on the automatic patterns for Spanish ID numbers (DNI and NIE), IBANs, email addresses and phone numbers. While you work, the areas are shown semi-transparent with a red border so you can check what will be covered. You choose the box colour and, if you like, a short text inside it, such as “Redacted”.

There are two methods. The default one, “Rasterise affected pages”, turns every page with areas into a 300 dpi image with the boxes already painted, as PDF24 does: no text or drawing is left underneath and the other pages do not change. The other one, “Remove only the content under the area”, deletes the characters that touch each area and turns into an image only the drawings, photos or groups that cross it, with their covered part left empty; the rest of the text on the page can still be selected, except text that shares a group with the covered content (for example on an imported or letterhead page), which becomes an image with it, and you are told so. Both remove the document metadata, the accessibility tags and the XFA layer, which can repeat the text, and cover the searched terms in bookmark titles, comments, links and fields as well. Before the file is handed to you it is read back: if any redacted text still appears on the pages or anywhere in the file, something is still drawn under an area or an area is left uncovered, it is not delivered and you are told so.
steps: Open the PDF: it is shown page by page in the redaction editor.
Mark the areas by hand, search for a text and redact all its matches, or apply the ID, IBAN, email and phone patterns.
Review the areas, choose the box colour and text, and save to download the redacted PDF.

faq.q: Why can I not select the text on some pages?
faq.a: With the “Rasterise” method, the redacted pages become images. If you need them to be searchable again, run them through OCR PDF: what you covered cannot come back, because it is no longer in the file. If you want to keep the text on the rest of the page, choose “Remove only the content under the area”.

faq.q: Do the patterns find every piece of data?
faq.a: They search the PDF text, so they cannot see anything inside an image or a scan without OCR, nor unusual formats. Always review the document and add by hand whatever is missing.

With “Rasterise”, links and annotations are removed from the redacted pages. With “Remove”, only those touching an area are removed, and a form field that touches an area is removed entirely. On the rest of the document they are kept, and so are the bookmarks.
